rules.prepare:
cd "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR" autoreconf -vfi bh_autotools_dev_update
# Only the library. Debian also builds the programs (--enable-app), which # need libev, jansson, c-ares and jemalloc. cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR/configure" \ --prefix="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" \ --build="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ --host="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ --disable-failmalloc \ --disable-silent-rules \ --enable-lib-only \ --enable-static
